dct_description_sm: The Shubenacadie (Indian Brook) Band must plan for its future development. Part of this development must take into account the impact climate change will have on the ability of members to have safe access to all parts of their community without the threat of flooding conditions.

dct_title_s: Climate Change in the Indian Brook Community
